evidence.title: AirTrunk breaks ground on TOK2; Begins construction on 110+MW facility in West Tokyo
evidence.excerpt: AirTrunk reports that it began construction of AirTrunk TOK2 in West Tokyo following a groundbreaking ceremony and describes the facility as 110+ MW without naming a capacity basis.
